title: Incrementing a base expansion
statement: For a positive integer base $b$, let the length-$n$ digit list of $c$ have entries $\lfloor c/b^k\rfloor \bmod b$ for $k=0,\ldots,n-1$, and increment a digit list by adding one to its first digit when that remains below $b$, or otherwise setting it to zero and carrying to the rest of the list. Then incrementing the length-$n$ digit list of $c$ in this way gives the length-$n$ digit list of $c+1$.
